record.paper_title: Open problems of the 32nd Workshop on Cycles and Colourings
record.original_question: For non-complete graphs G of order n, where δ(G) is the minimum degree and rc(G) is the rainbow connection number, does there exist a constant c≥0 such that δ(G) ≥ n/2+c always implies rc(G)=2? Here an edge-colored graph is rainbow connected if every two vertices are connected by a path whose edges all have different colors, and rc(G) is the minimum number of colors needed for such a coloring.

evidence.quote: Problem 4.1 Does there exist a constant c≥0 such that if G is a non-complete graph of order n with δ(G)≥n 2+c, then rc(G) = 2?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let G = (V, E) be a finite simple connected graph. An edge-coloring of G (not necessarily proper) is called a rainbow coloring if for every pair of distinct vertices u, v ∈ V there exists a u–v path all of whose edges receive pairwise distinct colors. The rainbow connection number rc(G) is the smallest number of colors in such an edge-coloring. Let δ(G) denote the minimum degree of G and let n = |V(G)|.

It is known that if δ(G) ≥ n/2 + log n then rc(G) = 2, while there exist graphs with δ(G) ≥ n/2 − 1 and rc(G) > 2 (e.g., two cliques of order n/2 joined by a single edge).

Question: Does there exist an absolute constant c ≥ 0 such that for every non-complete graph G of order n,
    δ(G) ≥ n/2 + c   implies   rc(G) = 2 ?
artifact.status_search_result: The best known sufficient condition is δ(G) ≥ n/2 + log n implying rc(G) = 2 (Krivelevich–Yuster type result, refined in subsequent work), while δ(G) ≥ n/2 − 1 is insufficient. Whether a constant additive term c suffices instead of log n appears to remain an open question; no source found establishing or refuting the existence of such a constant.

status_evidence.title: Rainbow connection and minimum degree
status_evidence.snippet: Minimum degree n/2 + log n guarantees rc(G) = 2; minimum degree n/2 - 1 does not.
status_evidence.claim: Best known sufficient bound is n/2 + log n, leaving a gap with the lower bound n/2 - 1.

status_evidence.title: An updated survey on rainbow connections of graphs
status_evidence.snippet: Survey discusses bounds on rc(G) in terms of minimum degree.
status_evidence.claim: Whether a constant c suffices in δ(G) ≥ n/2 + c ⇒ rc(G)=2 is listed among open problems.
